exposure: elective, first-stage, and second-stage cesarean sections
Mode of delivery: unassisted vaginal birth, assisted (instrumental) vaginal delivery, elective cesarean section, first-stage cesarean section, second-stage cesarean section
finding: Second-stage cesarean sections occurred in 1.7% of all deliveries, representing a continuing common occurrence in obstetric practice.
mod_finding: The incidence of second-stage cesarean sections was 1.7% of all deliveries, 2.0% of all women in labor, and 2.5% of all women who reached full dilatation.
